control.description-key: Simple section header label control to place inside a section. Can behave as a section or subsection label. Optionally align text or show a divider.

property.name: Label
property.description-key: Label text. Either plain text, or a JSON array of languageCode/label pairs, e.g. [{"languageCode": 1033, "label": "My Heading"}]. Falls back to the first entry.

property.name: IsSubsection
property.description-key: When true, decreases the label font size by 1px to indicate a subsection heading

property.name: DividerShow
property.description-key: Optionally show a horizontal divider beneath the label

property.name: DividerColor
property.description-key: Color used for the dividers border-top

property.name: MarginTop
property.description-key: Optionally add a fixed 4px top margin to the label container
